initiative.title: Role Routing Closeout Reliability
initiative.summary: Make automatically routed review overlays releasable without recursive review-claim creation.

taskset.summary: Repair the overlay claim lifecycle gap discovered while closing TASK-AR-594.

tasks.title: Make routed review overlays cleanly releasable
tasks.goal: Ensure role_routing overlay claims carry required lifecycle artifacts and releasing an overlay cannot recursively route another overlay.
tasks.summary: Add handoff/log artifacts at overlay creation and a recursion guard at release.
tasks.scope: Change the live-checkout role-routing claim creation/release seam and focused tests; preserve flag gating and additive review behavior. Host-template routing is out of scope because the generated host scaffold does not ship role_routing.py or enable this live-only seam.
acceptance: Every generated overlay claim points to existing handoff and log records.
Releasing an overlay with role routing enabled creates no nested REVIEW-REVIEW claim.
Ordinary worker release still routes the configured additive reviews exactly once.

units.title: Repair overlay lifecycle artifacts and recursion guard
units.context: TASK-AR-594 release generated two overlay claims without handoff/log pointers, so the standard release command refused them; after manual pointers, release would have routed nested overlays unless role routing was temporarily disabled.
units.scope: Create atomic handoff/log records together with each overlay claim and skip role-review routing when the released claim is itself an overlay.
steps: Add deterministic overlay handoff/log paths and atomic initial records.
Guard release-time routing for overlay claims while preserving ordinary release behavior.
Add end-to-end regression tests and confirm the untouched host-template lock remains current.
acceptance: Generated overlay lifecycle pointers resolve to files.
Overlay release succeeds with evidence and does not create nested overlays.
Focused routing and dispatcher suites pass.
units.handoff: Report the original failure, lifecycle artifact paths, recursion guard behavior, and focused test output.
units.stop_condition: Stop if overlay claims require a separate lifecycle schema or if suppressing recursive routing would skip ordinary worker closeout reviews.
